issues.description: The problem statement and UML require Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return a String (the message "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), and the template's Main uses System.out.println(m.messageOnMilk()) expecting a printable message. However, the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() with return type boolean and implementations print the message and return true. This return-type mismatch contradicts the specification and will confuse students and break expected behavior/output.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem specification by changing Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return String. Update Milkable.java to declare String messageOnMilk(); and modify Seal and Goat implementations to return the message string (e.g. "Seal Clarabelle is milked") instead of printing and returning boolean. Ensure Main and any tests print the returned String.
